notes.title: Headquarter update!
notes.content:
[b]2.0 update![/b]
We are back with new bosses,#and various major changes!



[b]-New bosses[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/508ada9024276a54dd3eac8b483562d37a5aa1e6.png[/img]
3 new bosses have been added: Badly Drawn Graphics, You are an Idiot.exe and Memory leak!
They will randomly appear in place of existing bosses at wave 6/12/18.



[b]-New Structures[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/998b4112675cf8f8b07df89fd40c27617323504b.png[/img]
Network card has been added!
Now you can get EXP in real-time during the game, and contact HQ to increase your security level.
Also, you can check the current game statistics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/52cab60f78374997a7c9cf822e2306b3989994a7.png[/img]
Battery has been added!
Feel free to change the game speed as you wish in Creative mode.



[b]-New features[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/54cf3cd673311c4c55090e6864ba2c835a516417.png[/img]
The Database has been renewed!
Check out the new Database to see information about related buffs/debuffs and drop items.
In addition, several user convenience features have been added, such as Crafting tab/Quickslot Lock.



-And more...
6 balance adjustments
30 system changes
9 design changes
And 23 bug fixes!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/332cf5046d6ddfd21c445276a54b4834ea815588.gif[/img]
Thank you for enjoying Vaccine A! Beep.
and also, Happy New Year!

notes.title: RTFM update!
notes.content:
New Boss
-'The Manual' has added!
The Manual appears at wave 24.
Be sure to read the manual before 'real battle' starts!

New mob
-Hack, Macro, Lag... 10 new mobs added.

New features
-Registry file system added!
Defeat bosses to earn registry file, and apply various upgrades in registry editor!
-Security type added!
Mobs with security type take half damage from attacks without that type.
Upgrade various vaccines wisely to cover your weak type.
-Vaccine status added!
Selecting vaccines now displays stats of that vaccine.
Let's see what upgrades fits best!
-Extra support on Minigame mode
Starting resources/Earn resource setting added.
Temp block, Sokoban block, break; added.

New event
-Backdoor added. Defend swarming mobs!

System changes
-Aim mode changes its target when original target dies.
It means you don't have to press Aim button again!
-Some perks changed
'Candle in the wind' changed to 'Quadruple cure-Triple cure shoots one more pill'
'Nuclear fusion' changed to 'V4: auto scan now fires plasma ball'
'Aftermath' changed to 'Autoclick-Character: macro upgrade is given when game starts'
'Sanctuary' damage increased from 25% of healing power to 150% of healing power.
-And a lot of things you won't care.

Balance changes: 100+ changes that you might not care!
-Difficulty decreased really slightly, as many reviews claimed it's too hard.
-A lot of Vaccine upgrade costs changed.

Bugfix
-13 bug fixed.

ETC.
-Added 1 new perk.
-Added 4 new achievements.
-Uploaded new video on iTube.

notes.title: Retro Time!
notes.content:
1.6.0 update!
Back with retro-game themed blocks, npcs, and Minigame mode!

New blocks
-'Game' category added in App market! unlocked in level 13.
Install Pec-Man, Tetramino, Space intruder, Super morio in App market!
-Resource tool added. All resource-related blocks now can be crafted in resource tool. Can be crafted in CPU.
-Disk defragmenter added. It collects dropped resources! Can be crafted in resource tool.
-Start point/End point/Save point/Sign added. Only for minigame mode.

New NPCs
-Help.txt added. He will give you basic tips about game!
-Minesweeper added. You know how to play it, right?
-Chrome dino added. You know how to play it too, right?
-Dr. Uhm added. Take one of these Minimons!
-Delza added. Find his master sword! ...as it's dangerous to go alone?
-

New Event
-Bug rain added. Bug is falling from the sky!

New Features
-Minigame mode added! You can make your own minigame by setting win conditions and more in creative mode. Share your map files with others!
-New structure 'Memory card' added! save/load your loadouts in creative mode.
-Added more settings in spawner in creative mode.
-Added more time settings in creative mode.
-Now displays map version on game selection window.
-Screen shake on/off option added.
-Steam screenshot now available. my mistake.
-and more tiny things you won't care.

System changes
-Converter now can convert non-energy resources too.
-iTube now don't show same video in a row.
-Acebook's buff ends when acebook destroyed.
-Can get different buffs in different acebooks in same time.
-Rocky's bone now displays on map.
-Fully generated Window media/Notepad/Paintbrush now drops generated energy when destroyed.
-Database now show NPCs too.
-and more tiny things you won't care.

Design changes
-Some turret's debuffs on mob now scales on mob's size.
-Buff/debuff's instruction window design changed.
-Added few UI in creative mode.
-Database UI changed.
-Bomber virus design changed. for evade copyright issues?
-and more tiny things you won't care.

Balance changes
-Increased NPC spawn chance by twice.
-V4's attack range increased by 16%.
-Rocky's attack speed increased by 14%.

Bugfix
-11 bug fixed.

ETC.
-Added 5 new perks.
-Added 5 new achievements.
-Uploaded new video on iTube.

*Vaccine A did not intend any copyright violation.
All programs appearing in-game are parodies of pure respect.
This game is not intended for commercial use.

It was fun to get global feedback! wow.
